subject: Escalation: Proposed burst pricing + reservation hold — AuroraAI Dedicated Request
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: AuroraAI - dedicated capacity ask (burst + reservation hold)

Hi team,

AuroraAI (Marta/Kevin) pushed back on the standard reservation cadence and are asking for three non-standard items we need exec sign-off on before I send formal terms:

1) GPU profile: prefer the A100-80GB High-Mem nodes for inference (model tightness — 40% perf bump vs standard).
2) Burst capacity: allow +50% burst over their monthly reservation for the first 6 months during nightly spikes (they expect burst windows 00:00-05:00 PST).
3) Reservation hold: procurement wants a 45-day hold on committing to the reservation while they finalize governance/PO.

They've requested a sizeable upfront commitment if we approve the above. Attached is the RDW_proposed_pricing_v3.pdf with the proposed discounted tiers and the Aurora_capacity_runbook.xlsx showing expected traffic patterns.

Key asks from me: do we approve the A100-80GB as an exception to the standard SKU list, sign off on the burst cap +50% for 6 months, and allow a 45-day reservation hold (we'd need a signed hold form and PO by day 45). If yes, Jordan will confirm terms and loop in legal/finance.

Thanks,
Jordan

--
Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Mar 2026 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AuroraAI - dedicated capacity ask (burst + reservation hold)

Thanks Jordan — flagging to escalate. Quick thoughts inline: 

> 1) GPU profile: prefer the A100-80GB High-Mem nodes for inference
Agree in principle for performance, but A100-80GB isn't in our standard Dedicated SKU pool for new customers in us-west. Approve as a one-off if we can get a 24-month commit or equivalent financial guarantee.

> 2) Burst capacity: allow +50% burst over their monthly reservation for the first 6 months
We should cap total regional burst to 50% but conditionally: require autoscale policies and pre-warming windows (we need ops input). Also want to discount the overage rate for that period — they're asking for a reduced overage, propose we review a concession.

> 3) Reservation hold: procurement wants a 45-day hold
45 days is longer than standard (30). We can consider 30–45 days if Finance can set a hard PO deadline and a non-refundable deposit (10%).

Laura — can you draft the minimal legal guardrails (PO terms, deposit language, SOC2 attestation requirement) and confirm acceptable overage concession? Grace — requesting your approval for the exception path (A100 SKU + extended hold) or escalation to execs.

I attached the pricing doc and runbook and added reservation_hold_form.docx that they signed preliminarily.

- Vivek
VP, Sales Operations
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Mar 2026 14:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AuroraAI - dedicated capacity ask (burst + reservation hold)

Vivek / Jordan — legal + finance POV below.

Summary recommendation (short): Approve conditional exceptions with these controls:
- GPU SKU: Approve A100-80GB for this account only, conditional on a 24-month minimum commitment OR a 12-month commitment + 10% non-refundable deposit.
- Burst: Approve up to +50% burst for first 6 months but set overage cap and step-down: overage charges during burst months = 1.5x standard overage (discounted from Jordan's proposed 1.2x). After month 6, revert to standard overage policy. Require telemetry hooks and pre-warming windows.
- Reservation hold: Reduce to 30 days formal hold. If customer insists on 45 days, require 10% deposit and DocuSign hold form signed within 7 days; hold expires at 45 days without deposit.

We also require: SOC2 attestation on file, PO referencing deal id RDW-2026-4231-AUR within hold window, and a single-point escalation contact in their procurement.

If the team approves these guardrails, Finance will produce a one-time onboarding credit (up to $25k) to be applied if they execute within 30 days. Legal will prepare the clause language.

Laura Bennett
Head of Legal, Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta@auroraai.com>, Kevin Tan <kevin.tan@auroraai.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Mar 2026 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: AuroraAI — proposed terms (conditional approval)

Marta / Kevin — following internal review we can proceed with the following conditional approvals:

- GPU profile: We will offer A100-80GB High-Mem nodes for AuroraAI. This is an account-specific SKU exception.
- Burst: We will allow up to +50% burst capacity for the first 6 months. Overage during the burst period will be billed at 1.5x standard overage rates (discounted concession).
- Reservation hold: We can place a reservation hold for up to 30 days. If you require the 45-day window, we will accept it only with a 10% non-refundable deposit and a signed reservation_hold_form within 7 days.

Additional requirements: SOC2 attestation on file and PO referencing deal ID RDW-2026-4231-AUR inside the hold window. Finance has authorized a one-time onboarding credit up to $25k if you execute within 30 days.

I attached the updated pricing summary (RDW_proposed_pricing_v3.pdf) and the capacity runbook. Please confirm which path you prefer (30-day hold vs 45-day with deposit) and we will generate the DocuSign.

Best,
Jordan
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: RDW_proposed_pricing_v3.pdf, Aurora_capacity_runbook.xlsx, reservation_hold_form.docx
